summary: Eight of the twenty base records survive the screens (R6807/R8212 as one deduplicated entity, R1278, R3282, R2008, R6608, R1596, R9925). Ranking qualified unique entities by distance ascending then most recent close gives the five selected comps: R6807 (0.80 mi, $125.00/sf), R1278 (1.03 mi, $135.17/sf after executed amendment U-R1278-1), R3282 (1.26 mi, $125.00/sf), R2008 (1.49 mi, $125.00/sf) and R6608 (1.72 mi, $125.00/sf). Median indicated value is $125.00/sf with a range of $125.00–$135.17/sf; R1596 and R9925 are qualified but fall outside the top five by distance. Exclusions were driven by wrong size unit (R8675), post-cutoff publication (R2044), minority interest (R4227), size outside range (R5215), unknown consideration (R2134), listing status (R8973), redevelopment (R7955), stale closing date (R6518), unallocated portfolio (R5660), distance (R1485), asset type (R1604) and related-party terms (R6806). Deliverable: comp-grid XLSX with live $/sf formulas and citations (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx).
limitations: U-R3282-2 (executed amendment restating consideration to $1) is published/effective 2026-09-10, after the cutoff; if it becomes effective evidence, R3282 would fail the positive-consideration test and R1596 (1.95 mi) would move into the shortlist.
U-R2008-3 ($5,000,000) is an unsigned draft; a later executed version would change R2008's price to $63.78/sf.
R2044 may be a qualifying comp on the merits but its only source postdates the cutoff, so it is unusable here.
R8675's 83,200 'acre' figure is presumed a unit error; no corrected source was supplied, so it is treated as unknown rather than 83,200 sf.
R2134's consideration is missing (unknown, not zero) — a subsequent disclosure could make it eligible at 4.25 mi.

Distances are as supplied in the extracts and were not independently verified; no adjustments were made for building age, clear height, tenancy or market conditions, so $/sf figures are unadjusted indications.
R8212 and R6807 are assumed to be the same transaction based on identical entity_id and deal terms.
